title: Most Popular Video Creator
summary: Given two string arrays creators and ids, and an integer array views, all of length n, calculate the total views for each creator.
statement: Given two string arrays creators and ids, and an integer array views, all of length n, calculate the total views for each creator. Identify the creators with the highest total views and their most viewed video ID. If multiple creators have the same highest total views, include all of them. For each creator, if multiple videos have the highest view count, select the lexicographically smallest ID. Return a 2D array where each element is a string array containing the creator's name and the ID of their most viewed video.
constraints: Sum views across all videos for each creator.
Return every creator tied for the greatest total, paired with that creator’s highest-view video id.
Break a creator’s video-view tie using the lexicographically smallest id; tied creator/id pairs may be returned in any order.
hints: For each creator, track the video with greatest individual views and smallest id on a tie.
Find the maximum creator total and emit all creators at that total in first-seen order.
The two maps independently capture the creator-level and video-level comparisons required by the result.
editorial: The two maps independently capture the creator-level and video-level comparisons required by the result.

tests.explanation: Alice and Bob each total ten views; Alice’s tied videos choose id one, while Bob chooses two.
Creator a is the only creator, and tied view counts choose the lexicographically smaller video id b.
